rows.decision: Ship release 4.2 on Thursday, not Tuesday.
rows.summary: QA found two crashes in the new export flow on Monday. The team weighed shipping Tuesday with export hidden against waiting two days. They chose to wait so export ships with the release.
rows.why: Export is the headline feature of 4.2, and sales already promised it to two customers.

quotes.author: Priya Nair
quotes.text: Both crashes are in the PDF path. I can have fixes in review by Wednesday noon.

quotes.author: Daniel Levi
quotes.text: Shipping without export makes 4.2 a release nobody asked for.

quotes.author: Maya Cohen
quotes.text: Thursday it is. I'll tell support and sales today.

rows.decision: Proposed: move auth from JWTs to server sessions (open)
rows.summary: Omer proposed server sessions so logouts take effect at once. Lena agreed on the problem but worries about load on Redis. They want numbers before deciding.
rows.why: Today a stolen token stays valid for up to an hour after logout.

quotes.author: Omer Shapiro
quotes.text: Revoking a JWT means a deny list, and at that point we have sessions with extra steps.

quotes.author: Lena Brandt
quotes.text: Fine by me if Redis holds up. Can we load test 50k sessions first?

rows.decision: Dark mode follows the system setting, with a manual switch in settings.
rows.summary: The team debated a toggle in the top bar against following the system. They settled on the system setting by default and a switch in settings for people who want to override it.
rows.why: Most users never change it, and a top bar toggle took space from search.

quotes.author: Noa Friedman
quotes.text: Under 3% of people touched the toggle in the beta.

quotes.author: Sam Okafor
quotes.text: System by default, override in settings. Done.

rows.decision: Keep Postgres for events and add a monthly partition.
rows.summary: The events table passed 400 million rows and queries slowed down. Ravi suggested moving to ClickHouse. The team chose to partition Postgres first and look again in the spring.
rows.why: Partitioning fixes the slow queries this quarter without running a second database.

quotes.author: Ravi Mehta
quotes.text: ClickHouse would be faster, but it's one more thing to keep alive at 3am.

quotes.author: Daniel Levi
quotes.text: Partition now, revisit in March with real numbers.

quotes.author: Omer Shapiro
quotes.text: I'll write the migration. Monthly partitions, kept for 18 months.

rows.decision: Hold office hours every second Wednesday at 17:00 UTC.
rows.summary: Members asked for a regular time to ask the team questions. A poll picked Wednesday evening in Europe, which is also morning on the US east coast.
rows.why: The poll had 140 votes and Wednesday 17:00 UTC won by a wide margin.

quotes.author: Lena Brandt
quotes.text: Every week burns us out. Every second week we can keep up.

quotes.author: Sam Okafor
quotes.text: First one is on the 21st. I'll post it in announcements.

rows.decision: Proposed: move the web and mobile apps into one repository (open)
rows.summary: Priya proposed one repository so shared code stops drifting between apps. Ravi likes it but wants a plan for CI times. Maya asked for a one-page plan before the next planning meeting.
rows.why: The same validation code lives in three places and has already caused two bugs.

quotes.author: Priya Nair
quotes.text: We copied the date parser three times. One of them still thinks 2027 is a leap year.

quotes.author: Ravi Mehta
quotes.text: Yes, if CI doesn't double. Let's see a plan.

rows.decision: The free plan keeps 3 projects and drops to 1 GB of storage.
rows.summary: Storage costs on free accounts doubled since spring. The team kept the project limit, which people like, and lowered storage, which few free users reach.
rows.why: Only 4% of free users store more than 1 GB, and storage is most of the cost.

quotes.author: Noa Friedman
quotes.text: People complain about project limits, nobody complains about storage.

quotes.author: Maya Cohen
quotes.text: We give 30 days' notice and a one-click upgrade. Agreed.

rows.decision: Version the public API in the URL, starting with /v2.
rows.summary: The team compared versions in headers with versions in the URL. Partners found headers confusing in the beta. The URL won.
rows.why: Three partners got the wrong version in the beta because they missed the header.

quotes.author: Ravi Mehta
quotes.text: If a partner can't see the version, they won't send it.

quotes.author: Omer Shapiro
quotes.text: /v2 in the path. /v1 stays up until March.

rows.decision: On-call moves from weekly to two-week shifts.
rows.summary: The team tried two-week shifts for a month. Too many people were on call during their own launches, so it was replaced by weekly shifts again on October 6.
rows.why: Longer shifts meant fewer handovers, which is where most missed alerts happened.

quotes.author: Daniel Levi
quotes.text: Most misses happen on Monday handover. Fewer handovers, fewer misses.

quotes.author: Priya Nair
quotes.text: Let's try it for a month and look at the numbers.
